name: Wu-Tang Clan
hook: Nine rappers from Staten Island, one producer, kung fu films, and a record deal that let every member sign somewhere else.
blurb: The Wu-Tang Clan came together in 1992 on Staten Island: RZA, GZA, Ol' Dirty Bastard, Method Man, Raekwon, Ghostface Killah, Inspectah Deck, U-God and Masta Killa. RZA made the beats. Their songs mixed dialogue from old kung fu films with dark, dusty loops. Their first album, Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers), came out in 1993. They matter as much for their business plan as for their sound. RZA set a condition that most labels refused and Loud Records' Steve Rifkind accepted: the group stayed together on Loud, but each member was free to sign solo deals with other companies. So within a few years Wu-Tang members were on almost every major label, spreading the group's sound, and RZA's production, across the industry. Ol' Dirty Bastard died in 2004.
